findings.problem: Original retained 10 ohm input resistor produced 662.913 V across 630 V C4 in an independent unloaded linear input-filter step screen.
findings.consequence: Specific modeled normal-startup rating flag required correction.
findings.evidence: reality.input-screen.py/json; reality.damping-screen.py/json. Final RF1 FW20A47R0JA closes this specific linear screen: C4 588.698 V, C1 706.299 V, L1 differential 324.453 V, C1 dV/dt 179.470 V/us. At 60 mArms, resistance tolerance and 2% hot increase, resistor loss 0.1812 W versus 2 W nominal.
findings.closure: 47 ohm same-family fusible resistor and 1 kV pulse C1 present in frozen source. Linear-model flag is closed; nonlinear L1, hot startup, pulse life, surge and clearing are not qualified by this calculation.

findings.problem: New WE-PD HV manufacturer guidance prohibits sensitive traces underneath the inductor body.
findings.consequence: An inherited smaller-body placement could invalidate feedback/noise assumptions.
findings.evidence: Final native read-only probe: maximum 12.5 mm square projected body at [114.25,115.75,126.75,128.25]; no BP/M overlap and no overlap of connected U1.3-to-R5.2 sensing path. Power connection terminating at T1.2 is distinguished from low-current sensing.
findings.closure: Final native geometry passes this explicitly bounded check. No EMC or dynamic feedback proof inferred.

findings.problem: Inherited current, C1 rating-basis and T1 thermal-target statements needed reconciliation with replacement parts and revised losses.
findings.consequence: Stale thresholds could mislead prototype testing.
findings.evidence: Frozen active metadata retains T1 90 C planning target; C1 individual conservative stop 80 C overrides grouped 85 C; input current reconciled to revised 1.1–2.1 W loss budget. R7 thermal assumptions no longer inherit unrelated VR25 data.
findings.closure: Corrected frozen metadata inspected; no measurements claimed.

findings.problem: No physical startup, steady-state, fault, hot-restart, surge or temperature measurements exist for the replacement magnetic component and protection combination.
findings.consequence: Desk screens cannot establish reliable current regulation, actual saturated inductance, AC core loss, MOV/fuse coordination or safe fault behavior.
findings.evidence: Declared no_physical_measurements; prototype-gates.SB01.json. T1 0.8 A Isat is typical at 10% inductance drop, not an absolute current maximum. 0.52 Arms rating and assumed core-loss/thermal resistance do not bound all real switching losses. Conditional 58–107 C estimate exceeds retained 90 C target in its high case.
findings.closure: Competent controlled lab measurements with declared stop conditions: LED current/ripple, peak startup and restart currents/voltages, hot operation at 40 C ambient, T1 temperature and current-limit recovery; nonlinear L1/surge/fault/protection verification. Do not claim closure from appearance, Isat comparison or resistor energy integral.

findings.problem: Full strict-spacing check still FAILS. Twenty-three reported numeric violation signatures match the prior baseline; matching does not transfer prior human acceptance to this changed source.
findings.consequence: Cannot label this new candidate fully spacing-passed or generally safety-qualified.
findings.evidence: Independent Counter comparison of sorted nets/kinds, conservative gap rounded to 4 decimals and target: baseline routing-order-prep/po_poprawkach/checks/strict-spacing.json and final candidate-views/strict-spacing.json both 23 and equal. Native DRC pass uses configured rules and does not override this separate check.
findings.closure: Exact new snapshot requires explicit bounded fabrication review/acceptance or design correction meeting stricter targets. All product/energization qualifications remain separate.
